title: We're New at This
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Ikuma Saeki finally marries Sumika, his childhood friend and longtime crush. Both are inexperienced, and the episodic comedy follows the newlyweds' awkward attempts at physical intimacy and married life. Later chapters skip ahead to parenthood.
life_message: Patience, honesty and humor let two inexperienced people grow into a close, faithful marriage.

content.note: Marital sex is the central theme; chapter titles such as 'Selfish Sex' (Wikipedia); nudity and ecchi (AniList Nudity 54; MangaDex suggestive).
